nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: Why have plastic bag bans or charges been generally favoured by the public according to various studies?
nodes.answer: Plastic bag bans or charges have been generally favoured by the public because consumers are increasingly normative in reusing their own bags for shopping.

nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: How did the plastic bag tax in Portugal impact plastic usage and risk perception?
nodes.answer: The plastic bag tax in Portugal was found to reduce plastic usage while also increasing the risk perception of the issue among consumers.
